source_instruction: i'm looking for a mid century home office desk chair that is easy to assemble. please choose the grey velvet one.
query: I spent 20 minutes this morning trying to hang a vintage wall clock above my desk, dropped the drywall anchor twice, and had to run to the hardware store for a replacement pack that ended up being the wrong size. My cat also knocked over my potted snake plant right as I was leaving, so I had to sweep up dirt from the rug before I could even sit down to shop. Since you probably don’t have any mid century home office chairs in stock anyway, just show me easy to assemble grey options under $160, yeah?
